more_info.overview: Monensin A is a polyether ionophore antibiotic component. Its ion-binding structure allows it to transport monovalent ions across lipid membranes. The general identity source discusses veterinary and biochemical contexts. This historical entry does not establish a typical current use as an ingredient added directly to human food.
